newsitem.title: USA: U.S. M-2 money supply up $8.9 bln in May 26 week. [CORRECTED 21:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: U.S. M-2 money supply up $8.9 bln in May 26 week. [CORRECTED 21:30 GMT]

text.p: U.S. M-2 money supply rose $8.9 billion in the May 26 week to $3,909.6 billion, the Federal Reserve said.
(Corrects direction of change in headline and first paragraph.)
The broader M-3 measure rose $3.0 billion to $5,058.9 billion. M-1 was up $3.7 billion to $1,064.9 billion, the Fed said.
The Fed said the four-week moving average of M-2 was $3,899.2 billion versus $3,898.6 billion in the previous week.
